semantic_cases.name: first_canonical_acceptance_enters_pending_atomically
semantic_cases.given: an ak.device.revoke passes schema, Event/proof, exact authority/device/current-generation, precondition, admission and canonical ControlProposalAck validation
invariants: accepted Event, canonical Ack, derived device/generation record and pending index commit atomically
record accepted_at and acceptance_seq are assigned by that atomic commit and accepted_at is not copied from an external Ack received_at
ak.device.revoke is never admitted through the Ack-less self-principal PCR exception
payload does not author target_device_authorize_event_id or target_device_generation_ref
no covering Seal or later decision is required to activate the pending gate

semantic_cases.name: unauthorized_proposal_has_zero_private_read_or_write
semantic_cases.given: the caller lacks the frozen revoke authority
semantic_cases.action: submit a syntactically valid proposal naming an existing or nonexistent device
invariants: authority is checked before device-private lookup
no Event, Ack, decision or pending record is written

semantic_cases.name: pending_blocks_closed_action_set_on_every_profile
semantic_cases.action: attempt each registered blocked action class
invariants: base and E2EE/hardening profiles have identical results
all failed actions have zero domain writes
local distinguishable operations use device_revocation_pending while KeyPackage anti-enumeration surfaces preserve opaque claim_failed

semantic_cases.name: session_issuer_uses_origin_ps_linearization_receipt
semantic_cases.given: an Account Authority has an immutable prepared grant intent for an exact account pair and device
semantic_cases.action: call ak.peer.device_revocations.command.check.v1 and commit the issuer record
invariants: origin derives the authorization Event and PCR generation from its own durable projection inside the gate transaction
gate decision and revoke acceptance serialize on one durable order
issuer commits the exact intent plus receipt before the at-most-30-second expires_at
pending blocks every later issue/refresh intent and cache/private RPC cannot replace the receipt
a Station accepting a protected self request checks its own durable gate locally in the request transaction rather than asking introspection to carry a reusable receipt

semantic_cases.name: initial_registration_or_recovery_issue_acquires_binding_from_the_allow_receipt
semantic_cases.given: a registration or dedicated recovery completion has established the account and device but has no predecessor SessionGrant binding
semantic_cases.action: call the gate with action_class session_grant_issue and no expected binding or accepted-device possession proof, then issue
invariants: the request is schema-valid without expected_device_authorize_event_id, expected_device_generation_ref or accepted_device_possession_proof
the allow receipt carries the origin-derived target_device_authorize_event_id and target_device_generation_ref
grant claims and introspection device_binding equal the receipt values verbatim
a client-supplied authorization Event or generation cannot reach the gate request or the grant
the gate is never skipped for want of a binding
a returning AccountHandoff uses returning_session_grant_issue instead and requires accepted_device_possession_proof

semantic_cases.name: unaccepted_device_gets_no_grant
semantic_cases.given: a device that ak.device.authorize has not accepted yet, and separately a device whose accepted authorization is pending or revoked
semantic_cases.action: run the gate for each and attempt issuance
invariants: authority_mismatch, revocation_pending, revoked and generation_mismatch all yield no grant
an unaccepted device must complete the anonymous pairing flow and durable ak.device.authorize before authenticating again
no bootstrap scope or missing-device_binding SessionGrant exists
a revoked or replaced generation cannot regain authority by being treated as a new device

semantic_cases.name: stale_expected_binding_fails_closed_without_disclosing_the_current_one
semantic_cases.given: a refresh or recovery-completion issuance whose verified durable binding names a generation the origin has already replaced
semantic_cases.action: call the gate with that expected binding
invariants: the receipt decision is generation_mismatch and carries no target_device_authorize_event_id or target_device_generation_ref
the issuer cannot upgrade a refresh to the replaced generation and must run a fresh session_grant_issue
expected_device_authorize_event_id and expected_device_generation_ref are rejected unless both are present
expected binding is omitted for registration/recovery session_grant_issue and returning_session_grant_issue, and required for refresh and the remaining action classes
recovery completion uses its verified terminal ledger evidence and never degrades to a client assertion

semantic_cases.name: gate_caller_authorization_precedes_any_private_device_lookup
semantic_cases.given: an authenticated service that is not the Account Authority bound to the named pair, an account this origin does not host, an unknown device, and a device owned by another account
semantic_cases.action: run a gate check for each
invariants: caller authorization is checked before any device-private read
all four inputs return the same authority_mismatch shape with no derived binding, blocker or Seal
device existence and account residency are not observable through timing-independent response content

semantic_cases.name: exact_replay_does_not_duplicate_or_extend_pending
semantic_cases.given: one accepted revoke Event and Ack
semantic_cases.action: replay byte-identical submission and restart the Station
invariants: no second pending record
no deadline extension
post-restart gate equals pre-restart gate without warm cache

semantic_cases.name: multiple_distinct_proposals_are_independent
semantic_cases.given: two different accepted proposal Event IDs target the same device and generation
semantic_cases.action: validly confirmed rejected command result only the first proposal
invariants: the first record becomes revocation_rejected
the second pending record remains and all five action classes stay blocked
account device summary returns all surviving pending records in canonical acceptance_seq then proposal_event_id order

semantic_cases.name: sealed_and_pending_records_remain_jointly_visible
semantic_cases.given: two accepted revoke proposals target the same device generation and a covering Seal terminally covers only the first
semantic_cases.action: read the account device summary and run a gate check
invariants: lifecycle status is revoked
revocation_states includes the sealed record and the other pending record
the gate decision is revoked and carries the covering Seal of the canonical smallest revoked record while the surviving pending record remains visible in account summary
one sealed record never hides or clears another proposal

semantic_cases.name: gate_record_bound_is_closed_without_truncation
semantic_cases.given: 128 distinct gate-relevant revoke records exist for one exact device generation
semantic_cases.action: submit a new distinct authorized revoke and then exact-replay an existing proposal
invariants: the new distinct proposal returns limit_exceeded with zero Event Ack or pending writes
the exact replay returns its original byte-identical accepted facts and consumes no new slot
the account summary never truncates a gate-relevant record

semantic_cases.name: gate_receipt_decision_shapes_are_closed
semantic_cases.given: the origin evaluates allow pending revoked authority-mismatch and generation-mismatch branches
semantic_cases.action: validate each receipt received over the deployment-internal authenticated channel and mutate forbidden branch fields or add a proof member
invariants: only allow carries target_device_authorize_event_id and target_device_generation_ref and every other decision rejects their presence
allow and mismatch carry neither blocker nor Seal
pending carries the lexicographically smallest pending blocker and no Seal while revoked carries the covering Seal of the smallest acceptance_seq then proposal_event_id revoked record and no blocker
a receipt carrying a proof or a verification_method member is rejected
a receipt that did not arrive over the registered deployment-internal authenticated channel is rejected

semantic_cases.name: only_exact_rejected_command_outcome_clears_last_pending
semantic_cases.action: accept a verified Seal rejecting this exact proposal unit; reject mismatched proposal, authority and device-generation binding
invariants: invalid Seal or mismatched unit changes no state
the unique confirmed rejected command result clears only this proposal gate
device returns to its independently verified lifecycle state
minimal recovery material retained during pending remains available

semantic_cases.name: overdue_stays_blocked_and_alerts
semantic_cases.given: the decision deadline and absolute deadline pass without a terminal Seal
semantic_cases.action: rebuild governance health and attempt a blocked action
invariants: device_revocation_pending remains the action error
control_proposal_decision_overdue is retained as governance/recovery fault
timeout, admin flag and cache eviction do not clear the gate

semantic_cases.name: command_outcome_is_unique_in_confirmed_sequence
semantic_cases.given: two candidate Seals propose different outcomes for the same proposal and predecessor
semantic_cases.action: confirm one candidate, then replay the other and restart
invariants: a confirmed rejected result cannot later become committed
a confirmed committed result cannot later become rejected
restart and exact replay preserve the unique confirmed result

semantic_cases.name: seal_makes_revocation_permanent_and_triggers_erasure
semantic_cases.given: an accepted Seal covers the pending proposal
invariants: covering_seal_id and sealed_at are durable truth
the revoked generation remains blocked after restart
client erases generation-specific session, KeyPackage and to-device material only now
a later competing command outcome cannot restore it

semantic_cases.name: historical_eligibility_is_recomputed_from_confirmed_closures
semantic_cases.given: the same original Event and verified historical authorization instance
semantic_cases.action: recompute after receiving the complete confirmed closure evidence
invariants: Event identity and original evidence are unchanged across cases
receiver accepted_at and arrival order do not decide persistent eligibility
historical import does not repeat live side effects
